fullPassage: Our homes aren't just ecosystems, they're unique ones, hosting species that are adapted to indoor environments and pushing evolution in new directions. Indoor microbes, insects, and rats have all evolved the ability to survive our chemical attacks, developing resistance to antibacterials, insecticides, and poisons. German cockroaches are known to have developed a distaste for glucose, which is commonly used as bait in roach traps. Some indoor insects, which have fewer opportunities to feed than their outdoor counterparts, seem to have developed the ability to survive when food is limited. Dunn and other ecologists have suggested that as the planet becomes more developed and more urban, more species will evolve the traits they need to thrive indoors. Over a long enough time period, indoor living could drive our evolution, too. Perhaps my indoorsy self represents the future of humanity.

det.analysis: 'developing __________ to'에서 developing의 목적어로 명사가 필요하므로 resist(동사) → resistance(명사)

questions.passage: Our homes aren't just ecosystems, they're unique ones, hosting species that are adapted to indoor environments and pushing evolution in new directions. Indoor microbes, insects, and rats have all evolved the ability to survive our chemical attacks, developing resistance to antibacterials, insecticides, and poisons. German cockroaches are known to have developed a distaste for glucose, which is commonly used as bait in roach traps. Some indoor insects, which have fewer opportunities to feed than their outdoor counterparts, seem to have developed the ability to survive when food is limited. Dunn and other ecologists have suggested that as the planet becomes more developed and more urban, more species will evolve the traits they need to thrive indoors. Over a long enough time period, indoor living could drive our evolution, too. Perhaps my indoorsy self represents the future of humanity.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 실내 적응 진화와 인간 진화
det.analysis:
❌ ① 바퀴벌레 박멸법: 예시일 뿐

❌ ② 먹이 습성 비교: 일부 내용일 뿐

❌ ③ 도시 발전사: 배경일 뿐

✅ ④ 실내 환경에 적응해 진화하며 인간의 진화까지 이끄는 집 속 생물들: 글의 핵심 ← 정답
det.tip: indoor species evolve + drive our evolution

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 영어로 쓰시오.
우리말: 미끼로 흔히 사용되는
[조건] (1) as, bait, commonly, is, used, which를 모두 사용 (2) 6단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: which is commonly used as bait = 미끼로 흔히 사용되는
det.analysis:
본문: 'glucose, which is commonly used as bait in roach traps' — 관계대명사 which(선행사 glucose) + 수동태 is used + as bait

[조건 검증] which(1) is(2) commonly(3) used(4) as(5) bait(6) = 6단어

questions.wa: which is commonly used as bait
accept: which is commonly used as bait
